content.title: Fashion Density Reset | Identity Lock, Recap Collage, Hero Mark
content.summary: Lock one clearly adult identity across coordinated fashion modules, escalate to a density peak, reset in a sparse full-character field, recap earlier states as a collage, then resolve to one clean hero mark.

quick_start.input_format: Clearly adult original character with three identity anchors + at least four multi-channel style modules + visible transition carriers + one density peak + one sparse full-character reset + recap of at least three prior states + one clean hero lockup
quick_start.recommended_input: A clearly adult male fashion performer with a shaved head and thin copper cheek stripe moves through mineral tailoring, transit-map, archival-paper, and industrial-signal modules. After a black-copper-red density peak, he enters a sparse ivory two-step runway, passes three prior-look contact sheets, and settles into an original AXIS NOIR hero mark.
required_anchors: Before the first switch, establish at least three identity anchors for one clearly adult original character and preserve them in every module.
Each style module must change at least two coordinated channels among wardrobe, layout, props, palette, and camera duty; a palette swap alone is not a new module.
Every module handoff must be visibly carried by a foreground object, graphic edge, fabric, or gesture, and one density peak must be followed by a substantially sparser full-character interval.
After the reset, recap at least three previously shown states, then clear to a hero frame where the character, original name, and one proposition are all readable.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, brand, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep identity anchors, module handoffs, the density reset, recap provenance, and final hero mark visibly causal.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 template and fill only the declared variable slots.
Before generation, check identity continuity, copy legibility, rhythm contrast, sound, and anti-copy distance.
applicable_scope: Lock one clearly adult identity across coordinated fashion modules, escalate to a density peak, reset in a sparse full-character field, recap earlier states as a collage, then resolve to one clean hero mark.
Original 4–15 second campaigns that can preserve every identity, density, recap, and hero-lockup anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need strong rhythmic contrast and a resolved campaign ending.
not_suitable_for: Requests to copy the source identity, brand, slogans, wardrobe, palette, or exact storyboard.
Concepts that cannot support a clearly sparse reset or cannot make the recap quote earlier states.
Loose multi-location narratives that do not need identity continuity or an advertising lockup.

creative_dna.mechanism: A clearly adult identity remains locked while action-led foreground carriers rotate through multiple coordinated fashion-and-graphic worlds; visual density climbs to overload, abruptly resets to a sparse full-character interval, then prior states return as a compact collage recap before one simple hero wordmark closes the campaign.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original character with at least three stable identity anchors before the first style switch, and preserve those anchors through every wardrobe and layout module.
invariants.ablation_failure: If face, age read, silhouette or signature anchors drift, the montage becomes unrelated models instead of one campaign identity proving range.

invariants.rule: Every style module must change at least two coordinated channels among wardrobe, palette, layout, prop system and camera duty; a palette swap alone does not count.
invariants.ablation_failure: If only color changes, the progression feels like a filter reel and loses the sense of distinct fashion worlds.

invariants.rule: Use visible foreground objects, graphic edges or character gestures as motivated handoffs between modules so action, camera and graphic transition occur in the same beat.
invariants.ablation_failure: If modules are connected by arbitrary cuts, the sequence keeps surface variety but loses causal flow and tactile momentum.

invariants.rule: Escalate visual and typographic density to one peak, then insert a substantially sparser full-character interval before the recap.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the sparse reset, constant maximal density flattens the rhythm and makes the final escalation feel no stronger than the middle.

invariants.rule: After the reset, visibly recap at least three earlier states as image fragments or registered panels before resolving to one simple hero lockup.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the hero card arrives without a recap, the ending reads as a disconnected poster rather than a payoff that gathers the campaign's prior evidence.

invariants.rule: Limit each module to one short original copy unit and preserve a clear subject-copy hierarchy, especially in the held final frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: Dense or malformed copy competes with the character, harms legibility and repeats the source prompt's own stated typography weakness.

slots.name: adult_identity
slots.description: One original clearly adult subject with at least three stable face, hair, silhouette or accessory anchors.

slots.name: style_modules
slots.description: At least four worlds that each change two or more coordinated channels, not palette alone.

slots.name: transition_carriers
slots.description: Foreground props, graphic edges, fabric, gestures or registered panels that motivate each handoff.

slots.name: density_peak
slots.description: The highest-load module where movement, copy and graphic layers converge without hiding identity.

slots.name: sparse_reset
slots.description: A full-character low-density interval with restrained camera and effects.

slots.name: recap_system
slots.description: Contact sheets, specimen cards, panels or fragments that visibly quote at least three earlier states.

slots.name: copy_units
slots.description: One original short word or phrase per module, plus one simple final name hierarchy.

slots.name: hero_lockup
slots.description: A held final frame that resolves the stable subject, campaign name and one concise proposition.

slots.name: sound_arc
slots.description: Original modular beat families, a restrained reset texture and a decisive return cue; complete silence is optional, not required.

anti_copy_exclusions: Do not use SOLVÉRA, KAWAII IS POWER, any source Japanese/Chinese slogans, Ima Studio or confusingly similar wording.
Do not reproduce the source heroine's face, hairstyle, body proportions, anime design or exact outfit sequence.
Do not reuse the Harajuku kawaii accessory inventory, exact pink/cyan/lavender/black/white/hot-pink order or exact source typography layouts.
Do not reproduce the exact source timing, triptych design, collage geometry, poses, camera path or soundtrack.
Do not treat the user prompt's self-evaluation sentences as generation instructions or observed evidence.

instantiations.description: A clearly adult original male fashion performer moves through mineral, transit-map, archival-tailoring and industrial-signal modules, then a white runway reset, contact-sheet recap and original AXIS NOIR hero lockup.

A clearly adult original nonbinary runner keeps face and silhouette anchors while footwear, terrain diagrams, reflective fabrics and motion graphics change as coordinated modules before a sparse testing lane and evidence-wall recap.

A clearly adult original female perfumer moves through glass, botanical ink, metallic vapor and monochrome laboratory modules, followed by a low-density white table walk, specimen-card recap and restrained final product-name hero frame.

failure_modes.failure: Character identity drifts between style modules.
failure_modes.repair: Declare three identity anchors, restate them in every module and include one explicit multi-panel verification before the density peak.
Require at least two coordinated changes among wardrobe, layout, prop system, medium and camera duty for each switch.
Assign a visible carrier to every handoff and make its movement cross the cut boundary.
Reserve one full-character low-density interval with fewer effects and calmer camera before the recap.

failure_modes.failure: Recap and hero frame feel unrelated.
failure_modes.repair: Populate recap panels from previously shown states, then let those panels physically clear toward the final name field.
Use one declared short copy unit per module, large simple letterforms and a held final lockup with no extra text.

transfer_tests.finding: A sports-product campaign preserves identity proof, coordinated modules, density reset and recap while changing character, action vocabulary, environments, props, copy and visual medium.
A slower luxury fragrance context can retain the same causal architecture using glass, vapor and specimen cards instead of kawaii fashion surfaces.

review.method: canonical-source English editorial pass with terminology, identity, and stable-token validation
